description: Plan v7 section 8.3 zero-boundary clause: maximumAbsoluteNumberScale is non-negative and zero builds, admitting only integer-scaled values. PluralOperands.validateNumericValue compares Math.abs((long) number.scale()), so both a positive scale (1.5, scale 1) and a negative scale (1E+1, scale -1) must be rejected while 15 (scale 0) resolves.
